newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy tax revenue rises 6.9 pct in Jan-Nov 1996.
newsitem.headline: Italy tax revenue rises 6.9 pct in Jan-Nov 1996.

text.p: Through November 1996, Italian tax revenue rose 6.9 percent to 423.759 trillion lire from 396.261 trillion a year ago, according to data in the Bank of Italy's statistical bulletin.
For the month of November, tax revenue rose to 41.748 trillion lire from 38.981 trillion lire.

In the 11-month period, the Italian Treasury collected 38.520 trillion lire from other sources, bringing the total to 462.281 trillion lire, up 6.6 percent from 433.650 trillion lire in the first eleven months of 1995.
